title: Mentored to death — the sponsorship flip (Priya, 34)
caption:
Myth: what she needs is another mentor. Women report more mentors than men, and fewer promotions (HBR, 2010). Sponsors say your name in rooms you're not in.
Send this to the woman you'd name.
www.aiforheratx.org
#sponsorship #womenatwork #brokenrung #womensupportingwomen #careergrowth

scenes.text: Everyone wants to *mentor* me. Nobody puts my name in the room.

scenes.text: Priya is 34, a data lead, and her fourth mentor just told her she is doing great.
phrases: She started thinking the problem was her.

scenes.text: The advice kept arriving. The promotion never did.
phrases: Let's grab coffee again next month.
I'll think of you when something opens.
I don't need coffee. I need my name in that meeting.

scenes.text: Send one three-line note upward, then say one woman's name in a room she isn't in.
phrases: Name the exact role you want.
Add one result with a number in it.
Ask: ‘Would you name me for it?’
Then say her name where it counts.
scenes.attribution: — Sylvia Ann Hewlett, (Forget a Mentor) Find a Sponsor (2013)
